answer: A flow-based trust network resists Sybil attacks by bounding reputation along an agent's operational voyage. Verifiers record endorsements in a cedar trust registry, routing credit through interaction graphs to trap adversarial nodes behind topological bottlenecks. An attacker deploying synthetic identities over shared copper links incurs the scarce cost of securing genuine trust edges from reputable agents. However, this creates severe bootstrapping friction for honest newcomers.
